cases.criterion: Participants generate a proposal from situated demand and acquired primitives, communicate it, independently consider it, and enact only exact consented terms; disagreement and counterproposals remain explicit.

A generated U7 attribution influences a communicated proposal, receives independent uptake, governs repeated observed work, and becomes a maintained public rule. Consequences name the actual bearer and preserve the causal chain.

U8 personal correction alone leaves public rules and obligations intact; public revision needs fresh current-member participation and changes later practice. Genuine danger, refusal, insufficient skill, missing access and low resources are distinct controls.
An active institution survives consented coordinator succession and founder departure. A newcomer is taught, processes the terms, and separately assents; teaching never grants primitive mastery.

Disputes, consent withdrawal and collective dissolution preserve prior costs, actual consequences, original commitments and unfinished work. Partial operations and changed authority cannot authorize stale or duplicated effects.

Independent raw audit checks institutional provenance, votes, rule versions, repetition, affected identities and inherited accounting. Exact checkpoint continuation, observation isolation, baseline integrity, and all 734 inherited distinct tests pass.
